verdict.rationale: LaunchDarkly's docs cover both halves of the story. Attribute-based targeting rules exist: SDKs pass any context attributes for use in targeting, and rules express conditions and precedence across context kinds. Reusable segments also exist, including converting rules into segments, plus individual targeting. Independent users corroborate this hands-on: ordered rules with ANDed conditions over arbitrary contexts, attribute rollouts like '10% of users in Rhode Island', group-level rules propagating to users, and Big Segments backed by Redis.
